answer: To register with Disability Support Services (Australia campus), fill in the registration form and arrange to meet with DSS. The form must be completed, signed and dated by a health professional (Part A) and by you (Parts B and C), and Part A cannot be completed by a relative or family friend.

points.text: Registration has three steps, and you can register at any time, but it is a good idea to do it before your units start.
points.quote: you can register at any time, but it’s a good idea to do it before your units start
points.title: Register for disability services

points.text: You can send a digital copy or a PDF of the form, starting by sending a digital copy to your health professional to complete.
points.quote: You can submit a digital copy or a PDF version of the form.
points.title: Register for disability services

points.text: If you already have supporting documents from a health professional, you don't need Part A; email DSS with those documents and a signed, dated Part C.
points.quote: you don’t need to complete Part A of the registration form – just send an email to DSS with:
points.title: Register for disability services

points.text: Registration is open to students with a range of conditions, including short-term injuries, mental health conditions and learning difficulties.
points.title: Register for disability services

citations.quote: The registration form needs to be completed, signed and dated by both a health professional (Part A) and the student seeking registration (Part B and Part C).

missing_info: The passages do not give a deadline for registering, the DSS contact details, or the location or link for the registration form. The Malaysian and Indonesian campuses are not covered by these passages; the registration steps given apply to the Australian campus only.
